name: StaffApplications
author: AfterWorld
short: Private staff applications with persistent controls and owner error alerts.
description: Public recruitment panels, resumable DM forms, durable staff delivery, reviewer decisions, and independent owner DM/private channel error alerts.
install_msg: Use [p]staffapp createchannels @Reviewers or [p]staffapp setup #applications #reviews #errors @Reviewers, then [p]staffapp open true. Read staffapplications/README.md before production use.
end_user_data_statement: Stores applicant/reviewer IDs, answers, positions, timestamps, decisions and message IDs locally. Submitted answers are posted in a configured private channel. Sanitized incidents go to bot-owner DMs and an error channel. Supports Red data deletion and configurable retention.
